processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: The two steel compositions (Fe–8Mn–3Al-0.2C = M1 and Fe–8Mn–3Al–1Si-0.2C = M2) were fabricated using a vacuum arc melting furnace. This is the first step producing the ingot from which sample M1-AC (as-cast) is taken.

processing_steps.method: remelting 4 times by flipping the ingot before each remelt
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: The melted ingot was remelted 4 times by flipping the ingot before each remelt to ensure complete and uniform melting of the raw materials throughout the ingot. This remelted ingot constitutes the as-cast condition M1-AC; no further thermo-mechanical treatment (homogenization, hot rolling, intercritical annealing) is applied to this specific sample (those define M1-HQ, M1-HR and M1-IA).

structures.overall_structure: As-cast ingot microstructure of M1 (Fe–8Mn–3Al–0.2C); optical micrograph shows a fine etched granular/dendritic contrast. No quantitative phase fractions, phase identification or grain size are reported for the as-cast (M1-AC) condition.

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Standard metallographic preparation (grinding, coarse and fine polishing) followed by chemical etching with 2 % Nital solution (2 ml nitric acid + 98 ml ethanol) for 10–15 s. Optical micrograph of M1-AC taken at a 100 µm scale bar.
characterization_methods.purpose: Obtain the microstructural image of the as-cast (M1-AC) sample
characterization_methods.key_findings: As-cast M1 shows a fine etched granular/dendritic contrast.

unmapped_findings: M1-AC is the as-cast condition listed in Table 1 ('As cast' → M1-AC) and represents the starting material of the M1 alloy before homogenization (1100 °C/2 h + water quenching), hot rolling (~50 % reduction at 1100–900 °C) and intercritical annealing (700 °C/1 h + water quenching).

The M1 alloy (Fe–8Mn–3Al–0.2C) was selected as the maximum Al addition (3 %) to the Fe–8Mn-0.2C system that does not introduce δ-ferrite in the intercritical temperature range; addition of 3 % Al widened the intercritical temperature (ICT) window from 88 °C (0Al) to 300 °C.
M1-AC is common in nomenclature to both steels (M1-AC and M2-AC) as the shared as-cast state; for M1 the specific nomenclature is M1-AC and for the Si-containing steel M2-AC.
